Three fixes: automatic streaming on Windows, a "Can't keep up" note that showed up when nothing was wrong, and dropdowns that opened cut short. The Temperature and Tint sliders also stop sticking.

## Changed

- The Temperature and Tint sliders no longer stick to set spots. Sticking helps where you often want one exact value, but white balance is a correction that depends on the room and the light, and there's no universal answer to which setting is right. Double-click still puts them back to 5500 K and 0.

## Fixed

- With **Stop streaming** set to "When no app uses the camera, even if I started it", a stream you started yourself never stopped if no app had opened the camera since Telescope launched. It now stops after the wait, the same as it does once an app has used the camera.
- The "Can't keep up" note could pop up right after starting a stream, switching lenses or changing the resolution or FPS, while the phone was still getting its camera going. Telescope now waits until frames are coming in again, plus a couple of seconds, before it judges the connection. If the phone still isn't sending properly after 10 seconds, the note shows as before.
- The phone picker and other dropdowns could open showing only one item when the window sat near the top of the screen and a lower item was selected. They now move down to fit instead of getting cut short.

Found something broken? Open an issue and paste your **Copy diagnostics** report into it.
